items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bill Anderson. Okay. [INTERVIEWEE] Right, right. And they came up with the thing they wanted me to cover, so.

ctx.x: Right, right. And they came up with the thing they wanted me to cover, so. And then I came up with a flip side. Well, when I went to record at this time, I had three tunes. And see that, that, that, that soul variety level, that's where my other three, my three tunes came out in those two albums. Uh-huh. And, uh, the only thing I got out of this was Marshall Sihon, I can quote it because I was quoting, I told him about it. He sold this, this variety soul thing to Japanese labor for a quarter of a million dollars.…
